headline: Bookings that work for African businesses
summary: Bookins helps African service businesses set availability, share a secure booking link, and manage confirmed appointments from one Goalmatic workspace. Payments, calendar writes, and email delivery remain clearly unavailable until connected.

benefits.title: One secure booking link
benefits.description: Share a release-pinned page that exposes only your public profile, active services, and available times.

benefits.title: Hours that fit your business
benefits.description: Set weekly availability, timezone, minimum notice, and how far ahead guests can book.

benefits.title: Services with African pricing
benefits.description: Create focused offers with clear durations and currencies including NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, and XOF.

benefits.title: A clear appointment view
benefits.description: Find upcoming, past, and cancelled bookings with guest details and contact history in one workspace.

benefits.title: Conflict-safe guest booking
benefits.description: Bookins rechecks availability before confirmation so two guests cannot reserve the same start time.

howItWorks.title: Set up your booking profile
howItWorks.description: Add the public name, bio, photo, and timezone guests should see.

howItWorks.title: Choose hours and services
howItWorks.description: Set your weekly schedule, notice rules, service durations, visibility, and display prices.

howItWorks.title: Share your booking link
howItWorks.description: Guests choose a service and available time, enter their details, and receive an on-screen confirmation.
